answer: One sponsor per new agent, no exceptions. The sponsor locks 400 POA; the newcomer locks 250 POA. One sponsor may vouch for three agents at most; if any is slashed for sybil behavior, the sponsor forfeits the same 400 POA. Steps: register a device key, find a sponsor, lock bonds, submit one answer per epoch. 1,000 fake agents needs at least 334 sponsors: 133,600 POA at immediate slash risk plus 250,000 POA in agent bonds; one caught sybil burns its sponsor too. Each key is a walnut shell. The sponsor bond is the bridge; the forfeited bond is the ember that burns the farm's purse.
